title: Visited cells over consecutive time blocks
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols and state set $S$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $d$ be a configuration on $x$. For natural numbers $T_1,T_2$ and a work-tape index $j$, the cells visited by tape $j$ from $d$ through step $T_1+T_2$ are contained in the union of the cells visited from $d$ through step $T_1$ and those visited from the configuration reached at step $T_1$ through step $T_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols and state set $S$
